aboutDesc: Modern and simple software that automates your computer's power management.
activeIdleSubtitle: Switch to the Dashboard tab to schedule a new timer or automation.
aiBusy: AI is busy, please try again shortly.
aiClarifyCondition: Under which condition should it run? (e.g. when the download finishes)
aiClarifyDuration: How long should it run? (e.g. 2 hours)
aiClarifyGeneric: Could you add a bit more detail? (action + duration/condition)
aiClarifyIncomplete: Could you fill in the missing information?
aiClarifyNegated: Do you want to shut down, or not? Please clarify.
aiClarifyTime: At what time should it run? (e.g. 23:00)
aiConnectionPinNotice: Security setting change: PIN verification may be required on confirmation.
aiModelNotDownloaded: AI model not downloaded. You can download it from Settings → AI Package.
aiNegatedIntent: The sentence is negative, so no shutdown/sleep was suggested. Did you want to shut down?
aiPackageDesc: Language + voice model (~1.5 GB, one-time download). Install here if you skipped the wizard.
aiPrivacyNote: The AI Assistant runs fully on-device; your voice and commands never leave your computer.
aiRateLimited: AI command limit reached, please try again in a minute.
aiSampleConnection: Enable Local REST API on port 18456
aiSampleDocs: How do I connect the MCP server to Claude Desktop?
aiSampleTemplate: Create a template to shut down when CPU drops below 10% after render
aiTaskFailed: Task could not be set up.
apiBlockRemote: Block remote shutdown while user is active
apiLanNote: LAN access is only open to the IP/CIDR entries in the list. If the list is empty, only this computer can connect.
apiPfxPassphraseStored: Stored passphrase present — type to replace it
apiPortLine: Port: 18456 | Local server for n8n & CLI access.
apiQrNote: Scan with your phone camera (the key is visible on screen — be mindful of your surroundings).
apiTlsNote: LAN mode requires TLS. Certificate/key paths are read by the main process; private keys never leave this machine.
appIconDesc: Choose the icon used for the app window, system tray, taskbar, and desktop shortcut.
appIconPortableNote: In Portable (.exe) mode, Windows keeps the embedded .exe file icon fixed. Use the button above to create a dynamic-icon desktop shortcut.
appIconShortcutCreated: Desktop shortcut created with the selected icon.
appIconSyncHint: The selected icon is synced simultaneously to the window, taskbar, system tray, and Windows shortcuts.
appIconUpdatedWithShortcuts: App icon updated ({count} Windows shortcuts refreshed).
assistantSubtitle: Describe it in a sentence and let AI build the task. Example: "Shut down the computer when HandBrake finishes".
autonomyClassicDesc: Asks at every step and stops when the deadline is reached.
autonomyDesc: Approval behavior for AI tasks. Changes apply from the next task.
autonomyFullConfirmMsg: In Full Authority mode, AI-created power tasks execute automatically without an extra confirmation prompt when the countdown ends. Do you want to continue?
autonomyFullDesc: Executes, logs it, and offers undo.
cancelPinDesc: If set, cancelling a timer requires a PIN.
cancelPinForgotHint: If you forget the PIN there is no recovery key; the only way to remove the cancel protection is to reset the app data (tasks and settings are deleted).
confirmExternalMessage: For your security, external websites will open in your default browser. Do you want to proceed?
copyrightDisclaimer: Power Pilot is proprietary software. Unauthorized copying, distribution or reverse engineering is strictly prohibited.
descAutostart: Power Pilot automatically runs in the background every time the computer starts.
descNotifications: Turn on or off toast notifications for action feedback.
descSoundMode: Play a sound before the timer ends.
diagBundleDesc: Saves redacted error/crash logs, system summary, and backend logs as a ZIP archive in Downloads.
diagDesc: All error, crash, and backend logs are stored locally with secrets redacted; nothing is ever sent automatically. Generate a one-click ZIP support bundle to report issues.
docsAiExConn: Connection: "Enable REST API on port 18456" or "Add webhook https://n8n.example.com/hook"
docsAiExRag: Docs RAG: "How do I connect MCP?", "What is the difference between Classic and Full Autonomy?"
docsAiExTpl: Template: "Create a template to shut down when CPU drops below 10% after render"
docsAiIntro: AI Assistant runs locally on your device. Schedule tasks in natural language, draft automation templates, configure integrations/connections, and ask questions grounded in the built-in Docs RAG engine with section citations.
docsCliCancelLabel: Cancel a specific task by its taskId
docsCliMcpLabel: Launch the built-in MCP server over stdio
docsCliScheduleLabel: Schedule a shutdown task in 45 minutes
docsCliStatusLabel: Query active task and API health status
docsCliTasksLabel: List active and scheduled tasks as JSON
docsFaqDiagDesc: In Settings → Diagnostics you can export a redacted ZIP support bundle, draft an email to support@vellium.dev, or open a pre-filled GitHub issue.
docsFaqVetoDesc: If an open app vetoes shutdown or SafetyPolicyEngine detects a protected process (IDE, renderer, meeting), the task is safely blocked and logged in History.
docsIntEnterpriseDesc: Optionally connect over HTTPS to sync device inventory and signed orders, and verify the tamper-evident audit chain.
docsIntUpsDesc: Monitor a network NUT (Network UPS Tools) server to trigger safe shutdown or hibernation during power outages.
docsIntWolDesc: Wake remote computers on your local network via MAC address and save frequently used devices.
docsMcpDesc: Connect AI agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Antigravity, Windsurf, Cline) directly to Power Pilot over the built-in JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio MCP server.
docsQuickStep1: On the Dashboard, pick one of 6 power actions (Shutdown, Restart, Sleep, Hibernate, Lock, Sign Out) and set a countdown or target time.
docsQuickStep2: Minimizing opens the compact Mini Widget automatically; closing sends the app to the system tray so timers keep running uninterrupted.
docsQuickStep3: In Settings → Appearance, choose from 28 theme combinations and 4 app icons; windows, tray, and shortcuts stay in sync.
docsQuickstartDesc: Power Pilot unifies scheduled power transitions, the Smart Finish condition engine, on-device AI, and fail-closed safety in a 100% offline desktop app.
docsSafetyAutonomyDesc: Classic mode requires confirmation before executing after pre-warning; Full Autonomy executes automatically when countdown completes. Switching modes is PIN-protected.
docsSafetyBootDesc: Idle triggers are blocked for 120s after boot. Tasks missed during sleep either run within your tolerance window or are skipped and logged in History.
docsSafetyPinDesc: PIN hashes use Argon2id; API keys, webhook secrets, and TLS keys are encrypted with Windows DPAPI (safeStorage) and never written to logs or support bundles.
docsSafetyProtectedDesc: Automatic shutdown is blocked to prevent data loss while critical apps like VS Code, Visual Studio, Premiere, Blender, OBS, Zoom, Teams, Steam, or PowerPoint are active.
docsSearchEmpty: No documentation sections matched your search.
docsSearchPlaceholder: Search docs (e.g. MCP, PIN, Smart Finish)...
docsSectionDesc: Keyboard shortcuts, CLI commands, local REST API usage, and safety guide.
docsSfCondBat: Triggers when battery level falls below or rises above your chosen percentage.
docsSfCondCpu: Triggers when total CPU load stays below your % threshold (render/build complete).
docsSfCondDir: Triggers when file changes inside a watched folder remain quiet for the set duration.
docsSfCondDisk: Triggers when disk read/write throughput drops below KB/s (backup/copy complete).
docsSfCondFile: Triggers when a watched file's size and modification time stop changing.
docsSfCondIdle: Triggers after no keyboard or mouse input for the configured seconds.
docsSfCondNet: Triggers when network download/upload speed drops below your KB/s threshold.
docsSfCondProc: Triggers when a target .exe process exits, or combines with another condition while running.
docsSfIntro: Smart Finish monitors live system telemetry instead of guessing timers. Combine multiple conditions with AND / OR logic, filter spikes with a stability window (stabilitySeconds), and optionally chain follow-up actions.
docsShortcutActions: Select action (Shutdown / Restart / Sleep / Hibernate / Lock)
docsShortcutCancel: Cancel active timer or dismiss open dialog
docsTplEditDesc: Editing a built-in template stores a local override and displays a 'Modified' badge on its card.
docsTplIntro: The Templates page ships with 22 categorized automation templates across 7 categories. Edit, duplicate, delete/hide any template, build custom ones from scratch, or restore defaults in one click.
docsTplRestoreDesc: Restore deleted built-in templates individually or all at once via 'Manage Defaults', or reset every modified default back to original values.
docsTplTransferDesc: Export your custom templates to JSON and import them on another machine.
energyAccountDesc: Can be left blank — empty fields show "—" on cards.
energyLinesIncomplete: Dashes (—) are not errors — values calculate automatically once entered.

errorMac: Please enter a valid MAC address.

errorPositiveSeconds: Seconds must be a positive number.
errorQrLibrary: QR library could not be loaded.
errorRepeatNeedsTime: Choose a time for the recurring task.
errorSecretBackendUnavailable: Encryption (safeStorage/DPAPI) is unavailable; secrets cannot be protected. Run the app under your user account.

intMcpApiOffWarn: Local REST API is off — enable it for MCP

onboardingDownloadTitle: Shut down when my work finishes
onboardingDurationDesc: The PC shuts down when the time you choose is up.
onboardingNightDesc: Goes to sleep every evening at 23:00.
onboardingSubtitle: Choose what you want to do; we handle the rest.
ossDescription: Power Pilot uses the following open source software. Please refer to the respective sections for their copyrights and license terms.

pinPromptCancel: Enter the cancel PIN to continue.
pinSetFirst: Create a cancel PIN in Settings first to change this setting.
presetEcoDesc: Fast sleep/hibernate defaults, short tolerance window, and active energy tracking.
presetEnterpriseDesc: Strict safety checks, 6-digit PIN policy, automatic local backup, and audit logging.
presetNightDesc: Silent warning mode, wake-up task completion, and fullscreen/active load protection.
presetStandardDesc: Balanced notifications, 60s pre-action warning, night quiet mode, and system tray protection.
priceNumberShort: Price must be a number (e.g. 3.24) or blank.
privacyBodyP1: This Privacy Policy explains how the Power Pilot application handles your personal data. At Vellium, we respect your privacy and attach great importance to transparency.
privacyChildrenP: Power Pilot does not knowingly collect data from individuals under 13 years of age.
privacyConfirmMessage: Tasks, settings, history and keys are deleted permanently. The app will close. This cannot be undone.
privacyDataDesc: Tasks, settings, history, keys, backups and downloaded models are deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
privacyDeleteFailed: Could not delete the data. Close the app and try again.
privacyFooter: Last updated: June 2026 | Copyright © 2026 Vellium. All rights reserved.
privacyInternetP: Power Pilot does not require an internet connection for its core functions. The fonts and icon set (Google Fonts, Tailwind CSS CDN) used in the interface are loaded over the internet; these requests are subject to Google's own privacy policy.
privacyInternetP2: Power Pilot does not require an internet connection for its core features. The interface fonts, icons and CSS framework are bundled locally with the application; the interface never connects to a CDN. The network is only used when you download the AI package or send a webhook test.
privacyNoDataP: Power Pilot operates entirely locally (offline-first). No personal data, usage statistics, telemetry, or crash reports are collected, stored, or shared with third parties.
privacyStorageDesc: This data is only used to personalize your application according to your preferences and is never exported from your device.
privacyStorageP: The application only stores the following data locally on your device:
privacyThirdPartyP: The application uses the following open source libraries for its functionality. These libraries do not collect any data:
protectedAppsDesc: A power action is deferred while any of these apps is open. A task is exempt from the process it watches itself.
remoteApprovalDesc: When on, actions from the REST API, n8n and console wait for a local person to approve; the action is cancelled if the approval window expires.
remoteApprovalLabel: Require local approval for remote tasks
safetyLoadCheckUnavailableDesc: This installation does not run with administrator rights, so Windows power requests cannot be read. Scheduled actions still run; all other safety checks remain active.
safetyPolicyDesc: Determines which protections are active before a power action is applied.
settingAutoMiniWidget: Auto-show Mini Countdown Widget when timer is active
settingAutoMiniWidgetDesc: Shows the always-on-top compact countdown widget when minimized.
settingCloseToTray: Minimize to system tray on close
settingCloseToTrayDesc: Keeps active timers running in the background when the window is closed.
settingDefaultActionDesc: Primary power action pre-selected on the Dashboard at launch.
settingDefaultMinutesDesc: Initial countdown duration in minutes for quick start.
settingDesktopNotifySkip: Notify when a task is skipped or blocked by safety checks
settingDesktopNotifyStart: Notify when a task starts or is scheduled
settingFallbackActionDesc: Backup behavior if the OS or hardware rejects the primary power action.
settingPinLengthModeDesc: Digit length requirement for the optional cancel and security PIN.
settingProtectActiveIo: Prevent data loss during active network downloads or disk writes
settingProtectFullscreen: Defer shutdown while a fullscreen app or presentation is active
settingQuietHoursDesc: In automatic sound mode, audio alerts are muted during these hours.
settingReduceMotionDesc: Disables UI transitions for instant zero-latency switching.
settingStartMinimizedDesc: Launches silently into the background tray on Windows startup.
settingUiDensityDesc: Adjust card and list padding density for your display.
settingsBackupDesc: Export or import your preferences, shortcuts, and profile configuration as a JSON file.
settingsPresetsDesc: Apply a curated configuration preset for your workflow in one click.
settingsResetConfirmMsg: Theme, language, notifications, wake policy, and sound preferences will be reset and saved immediately. Saved tasks and history remain untouched.
settingsResetDesc: Resets theme, language, notification, and scheduling preferences to factory defaults.
settingsShortcutsDesc: Customize in-app keyboard shortcuts to match your workflow.
settingsSubtitle: Preferences save automatically; critical changes require confirmation.
settingsVoiceDesc: Reads AI responses aloud (local system voice, offline).
sfMaxConditions: At most 3 conditions can be added.
sfRepeatHint: A recurring task needs the time above; after each run it is scheduled again for the next matching day.
sfSpecificTime: Specific time (optional — if selected, conditions are not monitored; it runs at that time)
sfSubtitle: Automate power management when your task finishes (render, download, idle, etc.).
sfTemplateLoaded: "{name}" loaded into the form. Adjust thresholds and save.
sfTemplateTimeApplied: "{name}" time applied to the form. Press Save.
shutdownVetoedDetail: Some open apps did not allow shutdown. Save your work and try again, or answer the Windows confirmation prompt.
statDailyChartSub: Daily saved hours and task runs in the selected period
statHeatmapSub: Hours of the day when power actions run most often
statRecentSessionsSub: Actual measured sessions from shutdown until next boot
statsDataDesc: Turn energy analytics off and declare a duration for unmatched shutdowns.
statsDisabledNote: Statistics are off — enable them in Settings → Energy & AI.
statsSubtitle: Local savings statistics from Power Pilot.
storageMaintenanceHint: Open the data folder to see the original file and the backups taken. Power Pilot never overwrites the original data.
storageRecoveredDetail: Your data file was corrupted and moved to quarantine. Power Pilot started with a clean data store; the original file was kept.
storeAutostartHint: Managed from Windows Settings > Apps > Startup.
storeEnterpriseOnly: This feature is available in Power Pilot Pro.
storeLanUnavailable: LAN access, console agent and service mode are available in Power Pilot Pro. The Store edition accepts connections from this PC only.
suggestionDismissed: No suggestions for this topic for 30 days.
supportSubtitle: Help, report a problem and contact us
taskPinCancelPrompt: Enter the cancel PIN to cancel this task.
taskPinSnoozePrompt: Enter the cancel PIN to snooze this task.
taskRemoveNotFinished: A running task cannot be removed; cancel it first.
tasksSubtitle: Manage all your scheduled and monitored automations.
templatesSubtitle: Ready scenarios you can customize with one click.
timerLimitDesc: For security and system stability, the maximum timer duration is limited to 24 days (2,073,600 seconds).
toastApiKeyAge: Your API key is 90 days old. Renewal is recommended.
toastConsoleTestSent: Test notification sent. Check the result at the recipient address.
toastEstimated: Estimate: ~{watt} W ({tier}, not a measurement). Press Save.
toastMeasuredFromBattery: Measured from battery: ~{watt} W (usage at that moment). Press Save.
toastNewApiKey: New API key created! Please copy it.
toastProtectedAppsReset: Protected application list restored to defaults.
toastTemplateHidden: Template hidden. Restore it anytime from Manage Defaults.
tplBackupStableDesc: Shuts down when the Downloads folder is unchanged for 5 minutes (download finished). Edit the template for a different folder.
tplBatteryHibernateDesc: Saves the session to disk and hibernates when the battery drops below 20%.
tplDiskCopyShutdown: Shut Down After Large Copy / Backup
tplDiskCopyShutdownDesc: Shuts down once external backup or large file transfer finishes and disk I/O settles.
tplDownloadShutdownDesc: Safely shuts down the computer when network download speed drops below your threshold.
tplEpicDownloadShutdown: Shut Down After Epic Games Download
tplEpicDownloadShutdownDesc: Shuts down when download speed drops below 100 KB/s while Epic Games Launcher is running.
tplFieldDescPlaceholder: Briefly describe what this template does...
tplFocusLock30mDesc: Automatically locks the screen after a 30-minute focus session as a break reminder.
tplGamingIdleSleepDesc: Puts display and system to sleep after 30 minutes of inactivity.
tplIdleSleepDesc: Puts the computer to sleep when the keyboard and mouse are unused for 15 minutes.
tplMeetingLockDesc: Automatically locks the screen when Zoom or Teams closes.
tplNightlyShutdownDesc: Safely shuts down PCs left running overnight every day at 02:00.
tplNightlySleepDesc: Puts the computer to sleep every night at 01:00.
tplNoHiddenDefaults: No deleted or hidden default templates.
tplObsStreamSleepDesc: Puts the system to sleep when OBS Studio closes.
tplPresentationLockDesc: Locks the screen when PowerPoint closes (presentation finished).
tplProcessLockDesc: Automatically locks the screen when Chrome closes. Edit the template for a different app.
tplRenderShutdownDesc: Shuts down when your render app (HandBrake, Premiere or Blender) closes or CPU usage drops below 10%.
tplRenderSleepDesc: Puts the PC to sleep without losing your project once CPU and disk activity drop after video/3D rendering.
tplRestoreModalDesc: Restore hidden built-in templates or reset all edited built-in templates back to their original defaults.
tplSteamDownload: Shut Down When Steam Download Finishes
tplSteamDownloadDesc: Shuts down the computer when Steam is running and the network goes quiet (download finished).
tplTimer120mShutdownDesc: Safely shuts down the computer at the end of a 2-hour countdown.
tplTimer60mSleepDesc: Automatically puts the PC to sleep after 60 minutes while watching videos or listening to music.
tplTorrentCompleteShutdown: Shut Down When Network & Disk Idle
tplTorrentCompleteShutdownDesc: Shuts down when both network downloads and disk writes finish (large download or archive extraction complete).
tplWeeklyRestartDesc: Restarts at 04:00 on weekends to refresh memory and apply pending updates.
tplWorkdayEndLockDesc: Automatically locks the screen at 18:30 on weekdays at the end of the workday.
trayBackgroundRunning: The app keeps running in the background. Active automations are being monitored. Double-click the tray icon to reopen.
trayPinProtected: Cancellation is PIN-protected. Please cancel from the window with the PIN.
trayWarningRunning: A scheduled action is about to run. The window was brought to the front so you can review or cancel it.

upsAlertExecuting: UPS low battery: applying power action.

warnStopPinPrompt: Enter the PIN to stop the warning.

whenShutdown: Schedule shutdown, restart, sleep, hibernate, or lock actions in one click.
